articles.title: A Cosmic Illusion? New Study Suggests Dark Energy Might Not Exist
articles.summary: A controversial new study claims the universe's acceleration is a mirage caused by our own motion through space. If true, dark energy—a cornerstone of modern cosmology—might be unnecessary. The finding hinges on a subtle correction to supernova brightness.

articles.title: Buried for 250 Years: Inside America's 2026 Time Capsule
articles.summary: Sealed on July 4, 2026, a time capsule near Independence Hall holds artifacts from all 50 states—a diamond, a Civil War eagle feather, an AI prediction—and a letter to the future. It's engineered to survive until America's 500th birthday in 2276.

articles.title: Country's Clean Sweep: How the Genre Took Over the Entire Top 5 of the Hot 100
articles.summary: For the first time, country songs occupy all top five spots on the Billboard Hot 100. Ella Langley's 'Choosin' Texas' leads the pack at 16 weeks at No. 1, followed by Morgan Wallen, Taylor Swift, and Stella Lefty. The historic feat caps years of genre crossover.
